utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Ira, are the club dues due now, or later this week?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I think they’re due by the end of the week, not right now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it, I’ll pay by the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can help with that. How much are the dues this month?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think it's twenty bucks this month, unless that changed again.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, twenty sounds about right. I can cover mine this month.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the dues are due this week, Pia. I heard they’re keeping it the same amount as last month.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Right, I should check whether we can cover it without scrambling at the last minute.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Maybe set aside a little extra now so it doesn’t turn into a rush later.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that. Just let me know what the dues are and I’ll get it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The dues are $25 a month, and I’ll need them paid by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it, I’ll have the $25 ready by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure, I can help with that. What are the dues this month?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think it's twelve dollars this month.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Twelve dollars sounds right to me. I’ll bring it by and tell the others so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo, the dues are due this week. If you need a little more time, let me know and I can work with you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa. I may need a little extra time, and I’ll let you know soon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Leo. Just keep me posted, and we’ll make sure it works for you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Dane, could you confirm the exact dues amount and when it’s due?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I believe it’s $20, due by the end of this week.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, just to confirm: it’s $20 total and due by the end of this week, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can cover the dues, but I need to know when they’re due and how much it is.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: They’re due on the first, and it’s $25 a month. I can remind you again closer to the date.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Okay, thanks. Just remind me when it gets close to the first, and I’ll make sure it’s covered.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m a bit behind on that—what did Jules say the dues are this time?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I think it was twenty bucks this month.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, twenty bucks sounds doable, right? I’ll probably just bring that then.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll pay my share. How much do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirm the amount first. I want to make sure we’re talking about the same dues.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I mean the club dues you mentioned earlier, the same amount we were talking about before.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can pay my share, but I’d like to know exactly how much the dues are.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, I think it’s just ten dollars each. If I mixed that up, I’ll check and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, I can bring ten dollars.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll bring up the dues with Cleo and make sure we’re on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, let’s keep the dues straight so we’re all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’ll bring it up with Cleo and keep the dues clear.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the dues are due soon, right? I can ask around and see if anyone knows the exact amount.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I heard they’re coming up soon. If you find the amount, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll check around and tell you as soon as I find the exact amount.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the dues. I think I still owe mine, but I need to check my wallet first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Take your time. I can remind you after you check your wallet.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, I’ll check it now.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the dues. I think I paid mine already, but I might be mixing it up with last month.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries - we can check your receipt or the ledger and sort it out quickly.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that sounds easiest. Let’s check the ledger and see what it says.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can spot you for now if you need a minute, Eli. Just let me know when you can cover the dues.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll settle up at the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No rush, Eli. Just catch me at the next meeting and we’ll square it up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure thing — I can cover my share of the dues this week.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, then I’ll get the dues paid up and we can keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll have my share ready this week too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Opal, I can help sort the dues out if you want. What’s the amount and when do you need it by?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s $25, and I need it by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I can cover the $25 and get it to you by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo, let’s sort out the dues together so it’s easy on everyone. If you’re short this month, just let me know and we can work something out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa. I can cover my part this month, and if I’m short next time I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo. I appreciate you being straight with me, and we’ll keep it flexible if next month gets tight.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the dues were due this week, but I’m not sure if the amount changed. Did Mina say where to drop them off?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I think the dues are the same, and you can drop them off with me or leave them at the clubhouse desk.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’ll drop mine off with you then.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can pay mine. What’s the amount?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s $20 for the month.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll bring $20.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that. Let me know what the dues amount is and I’ll handle it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’ll cover the dues once I tell you the amount?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’ll cover it once you tell me the amount.
